name: Primeval Thorn
description: Drive a thorn as old as the first forest through the opponent's guard and body.

name: Ancient Bark
description: Wear the thousand-ring bark of an ancient tree that no edge or fire has ever pierced.

name: Rootwoven Mend
description: Weave a fine web of root qi through an ally's body and draw broken parts back together.

name: Greenstorm
description: Whirl a storm of leaf and thorn that scours the whole front in one wild rush.

name: Primordial Bloom
description: Open a flower the size of a hall whose petals cut and whose scent dulls the mind.

name: Elderwood Rebirth
description: Draw a new shoot of life from the heartwood into one whose breath has just stopped.

name: Seedfall
description: Rain a dense fall of seeds that sprout into thorned trees where they strike.

name: Heartwood Dominion
description: Press the full weight of heartwood qi on every foe in reach until they can hardly move.

name: First Growth
description: Wake the first growth in every ally in reach as the school's greatest quickening.

name: Seedborn Vow
description: Swear the seedborn vow and stand in a ring of rising trees that grows with every blow.

name: Primeval Overgrowth
description: Loose the oldest growth in one rush that smothers all before it to the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Firstseed
description: Grow a living tree out of empty air with no seed or soil or qi spent in it which no energy mechanic explains.

name: Season Lash
description: Lash a bough of changing season across the opponent so each stroke bites differently.

name: Sapfall Veil
description: Let a slow veil of golden sap fall about the body that thickens and hardens under every blow.

name: Springsong Mend
description: Sing the warm notes of spring qi over an ally until new flesh rises under old wounds.

name: Autumn Reap
description: Sweep a golden scythe of qi that cuts down all within reach like ripe grain.

name: Cycle Bloom
description: Open and shut a bloom in a breath again and again so the petals cut with each cycle.

name: Wintering Bark
description: Draw all life into the bark and stand through any assault as a tree through winter.

name: Springtide Rebirth
description: Bring a spring tide of life qi to a person whose life has just failed and restart the heart.

name: Harvest Cut
description: Cut once with the whole ripened strength of the year through guard and body.

name: Annual Ring
description: Add one ring of growth after another in a chain of strokes as the school's closing sequence.

name: Ring Eternal
description: Hold the countless rings of the old tree around the user as the school's last guard.

name: Great Harvest
description: Reap everything standing within reach in a single cut of the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Returning Spring
description: Call back one past spring over a living thing so its hurt is undone which no energy mechanic explains.
